title: Data loss
body:
I have been using streaks for a year. Today I updated to latest version after 5-7 months delay and I lost all my tasks. Everything is empty. 
iCloud sync was enabled. Any ways to get data back?

title: Great app well worth to buy
body:
This is a great simple app well worth its price. The benefits of building positive and eliminating negative habits could not be underestimated. 

If you on the fence whether to buy or not, I advice you - buy!

title: The app is good
body:
I’ve been using it for almost 8 months and developed many useful habits, and I would like to do more. Is there a way to add more habits (instead of having maximum 12 at time) ?

Streaks is amazing, but having only 12 make it a bit worse
